oracle.derivation: two unit triangles sharing edge (0,1); dihedral angle pi/2 by orthonormal planes z=0 and y=0

tolerances.near_zero_policy: Distinguish absolute and relative error. A residual is near-zero only if |r| <= 1e-15 * nonzero_reference_scale or r is an exact integer zero.

provenance: Original analytic construction; no imported dataset; oracle values are closed-form or exact-integer and are not derived from QualiaDB/Etalon/Hypermedia implementation helpers
spec_exposure: Open boundaries, sharp CAD features, protected pivots
